trial.heading: Play The Last Tide

trial.decisionPrompt: Seawater washes over the console. There is only enough backup power for one task. The beacon can guide the rescue boat in, or the floodgate can protect the low-lying neighborhood.

trial.gateOutcome: The low-lying neighborhood escaped the surge. Without the beacon, the rescue boat has to wait for daylight to dock.

materials.question: Can I start with assets I already have?
materials.answer: Yes. Import existing text, images, audio, and video. You can also make scripts, character images, storyboards, and video under Assets → Generate assets.

models.question: What do I need to set up before generating assets?
models.answer: Check Model settings for the models available to your account and configure your chosen service. Before submitting a video job, you can review the first and last frames and the generation settings.

codex.question: How can local Codex arrange my story?
codex.answer: Open Ask AI → Connect your Codex in the project. Sign in to Codex CLI on your computer and pair it. Codex can edit the scenes, timeline, and interactions you authorize, and you can keep making edits manually.

play.question: Do viewers have to sign in or install anything?
play.answer: Viewers can open a published film directly from its link in a browser. Sign in to create and manage your own projects.

publish.question: What becomes public when I publish?
publish.answer: You choose the fixed version, cover, and trailer to publish. Drafts, conversations, and credentials stay in the project. You can take down a published film.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: How SceneTurn uses data when you sign in, create a project, and share it for public playback.

account.title: Accounts and project data
account.body: Your email address is used to register and sign in. The workspace stores projects, assets, task status, and project history. Account permissions control access.

generation.title: Generation services and personal Codex
generation.body: Prompts and reference assets needed to generate media are sent to the selected service. A personal Codex connection is scoped to the paired project. Codex sign-in credentials remain on your device.

publication.title: Public works
publication.body: Once you publish a fixed version, visitors can access its playback content and the selected cover and trailer. Removing the publication blocks new public access requests.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.description: Review assets, generated results, and publication settings when creating and releasing interactive works in SceneTurn.

content.title: Works and assets
content.body: Check that you have permission to use the assets you upload. Review generated results before adopting them or publishing a work.

generation.title: Generation and confirmation
generation.body: Before generating video, check the shot, first and last frames, and settings. Once results are in the asset library, you can preview them and select the version to use.

publication.title: Publishing and unpublishing
publication.body: Play through the story branches before publishing. The gallery plays the fixed version you confirm for release. You can remove a publication from its version settings.
